title: Scalar cup on a paired resolution class
statement: For a field k, a scheme X over Spec k, a module cup resolution pairing D of F and G, and cycles a, b, c in degrees p, q, and p+q with c.val = D.pair p q ⊤ a.val b.val, the scalar cohomology cup of D.left.class p a and D.right.class q b equals D.target.class (p+q) c.

proof.text: Choose injective-resolution comparisons for the three acyclic resolutions. The cocycle formula for moduleExtEquiv identifies each resolution class with the scalar Ext class obtained by evaluating the unit at 1. Restriction to k carries the signed Yoneda tensor construction to the sectionwise pairing D.pair, and scalarTensorCoefficient sends pure tensors to D.pair. The Leibniz equation identifies the resulting target cocycle with c. Naturality of Ext composition and homotopy independence of resolution comparisons then give the displayed equality, including degree zero, zero coefficients and empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCup_resolution_class_compatibility
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F G : X.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
    (D : CupResolutionPairing F G)
    (a : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.left.K).sc p).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
    (b : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.right.K).sc q).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
    (c : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.target.K).sc (p + q)).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
    (hc : c.val = D.pair p q ⊤ a.val b.val) :
    scalarCohomologyCup f F G p q (D.left.class p a) (D.right.class q b) =
      D.target.class (p + q) c
